communication: The Answering Agent produces an answer. The Evaluator Agent compares it with the reference dataset and returns PASS or REVISE plus feedback. The feedback is passed back to the Answering Agent for at most one revision.
stopping_condition: Stop after PASS or after the second answer attempt.
validation_process: The candidate lesson is evaluated on validation_data.json before it is retained. It is kept only when failed cases improve, previously correct cases do not regress, and unrelated question types remain grounded.
limitation: The evaluator depends on curated reference facts and keyword-based trial identification, so unseen trial names require additional reference data or a stronger retrieval method.
